description: Map your requirements to concrete evidence in the portfolio. Returns, per criterion, the matching projects/roles/education/writing (with ids you can use in publish_tailored_view), per-skill evidence, and gaps where no written evidence exists. Lexical and conservative: use your own judgment on top.

criteria.description: Requirements to check, one per item, e.g. "Has shipped a design system" or "Has run Postgres in production"

name: match_criteria
title: Match criteria to evidence
